tracks.title: Kuda Tak Mahu Jalan
tracks.genre: Bajau dalling-dalling (Sabah west-coast gambus and tambourine dance song)
tracks.subject: A Bajau boy in Kota Belud grooming his pony Si Merah for the horsemen's parade, who finds the pony only trots when someone sings the dalling-dalling, so he must sing the whole parade route.
